references.title: Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) s.37(4)
references.quote: A personal data breach must be notified to the Office of the Personal Data Protection Committee without delay and within 72 hours of awareness.

name: Personal data to be sent or transferred abroad (PDPA s.28)

references.title: Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) s.28
references.quote: A transfer of personal data to a foreign country requires the protection standard and safeguards the Act prescribes.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.120 para 1 (as replaced by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562)
references.quote: The employer posts the relocation notice at the workplace at least 30 days before the move.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.120 para 3 (as replaced by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562)
references.quote: An employee whose ordinary living is substantially affected may refuse the relocation in writing.

name: Employee relocation refusal disputed (open on written-notice receipt)

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.120 para 5 (as replaced by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562)
references.quote: A disputed refusal is petitioned to the Labour Welfare Committee within 30 days of the refusal.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.120/1 (as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562)
references.quote: The Labour Welfare Committee orders the employer to pay compensation or the employee to work at the new place; a court challenge is filed within 30 days.

name: Qualifying employee training completed (open on actual course completion)

references.title: Skill Development Promotion Committee notice of 21 September 2016, clause 4
references.quote: An application for approval of an employee upskilling or retraining course and its costs is filed within 60 days after completion and no later than 15 January of the following year.

name: Employee’s prior written consent to specified deductions

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.76
references.quote: A deduction above the statutory limit needs the employee's prior written consent, naming the deduction and its amount or limit.

name: Actual security money received from the employee

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.10
references.quote: Security money may be taken only for work, in the amounts and by the keeping method the Minister's notification allows.

name: Actual overseas work dates and country

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.5, 70
references.quote: Wages are money paid for work in normal working time; the employer keeps the wage record that evidences the actual work dates and place.

name: Original external wage payment or cost allocation

references.title: Revenue Code s.40(1); Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5
references.quote: Employment income includes wages and other benefits paid for work; the record evidences the actual payer and the cost allocation.

name: Actual service attributable to a benefit award

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.118
references.quote: Severance is measured by continuous service; the record evidences the service behind a benefit award.
